greeting.text: Hmph. You need something, or you just here to gawk at a dwarf working?

responses.text: Aldric said he has iron scraps for you.

shop.text: Every piece, forged by these hands. No shortcuts. No cheap alloys. You get what you pay for here.

browse_weapons.text: Swords, axes, maces. Pick your poison. The hand-and-a-half is my finest work this season.

responses.text: Let me see the armor instead.

browse_armor.text: Chainmail, plate, shields. Won't win any beauty contests, but it'll keep your insides inside.

repairs.text: Aye, bring it here. Won't be cheap, but it'll hold. I don't do shoddy work.

responses.text: How much for a full overhaul?

repair_cost.text: Depends on the damage. Dented plate, ten coin. Shattered blade, fifty. Miracle work costs extra.

buy_ore.text: Ore, eh? Let me see it. I pay fair for good stone. Try to cheat me and you'll regret it.

responses.text: Where's the best place to mine around here?

mining_tips.text: Ironmaw foothills, northeast. Rich veins. Watch for cave crawlers, though. Nasty things.

responses.text: Ironmaw? That's where your clan is from?

about_thorgrim.text: Thorgrim. Ironbark clan. Been swinging hammers since before your grandparents were born. That enough?

responses.text: Fair enough. Let me see your wares.

left_mountains.text: Disagreement with the elders. My way or theirs. Chose my way. Don't ask more. It's done.

responses.text: I'll leave you to your work.

miss_home.text: Every damn day. The sound of a hundred hammers echoing off granite. Nothing like it. But I made my choice.

maybe_return.text: Hmph. Maybe. When the world stops needing swords. So, never. Now, you buying something or not?

ironmaw_clan.text: Best smiths in the Ironmaw Mountains. We forge deep-steel. Stronger, lighter. Secrets passed down millennia.

deep_steel.text: Need Ironmaw ore. Bring me some and I'll show you what a real blade looks like. Not a promise I make lightly.

responses.text: Where would I find that ore?

aldric_scraps.text: Old Aldric? Hah. That man hoards scrap like a dragon hoards gold. Tell him I'll send the boy to fetch it.

responses.text: He seemed grateful someone helped him.

aldric_fondness.text: Good man, Aldric. Stubborn as granite, but good. This town would starve without his fields. Don't tell him I said that.

responses.text: Your secret's safe. Show me your wares.

end_shop.text: Come back when you need steel. I'll be here. Always am.

end.text: Hmph. Got work to do. Hammer doesn't swing itself.
